CAMERA: REAR ELEVATION, camera orbit 180 degrees from front, level with product center, exact back; original front-facing features hidden on opposite side. Preserve the reference's exact proportions, color, woven material, strip crossings, number/placement of compartments, handles, legs, pads, ribs, hinges and other components. Reference photo defines actual visible design; do not redesign or add components. Reveal its described hidden rear structures coherently. Finish natural matte honey-tan fibers, primary weave close herringbone V-shaped twill; same lighting, scale and placement. Full product centered with margins, plain warm-white seamless backdrop, soft studio lighting/subtle shadow, sharp natural fiber detail, square. Empty product, no props, room, people, animals, plants, food or extra products. No mirror-flip substitute, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, numbers, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, inscriptions or measurements anywhere.
